notes.title: Summit Drive Demo Update Version 1.3.5
notes.notes: [h2][b]What was updated?[/b][/h2][h3][u]Main Menu:[/u][/h3][list][*][p]Main menu music added into the game[/p][/*][*][p]Camera pans closer to character when played[/p][/*][*][p]Option to select different mountain/maps has been added in preparation for the release[/p][/*][*][p]Version number added at the bottom of the screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fonts were changed due to copyright restrictions[/p][/*][/list][h3][u]Additional Updates:[/u][/h3][list][*][p]Thomas Perrone will be doing the composition/OST for Summit Drive[/p][/*][*][p]Credit was added into the game[/p][/*][/list][h3][u]Bug Fixes:[/u][/h3][list][*][p]Decreased collider of some trees found at the top of the mountain[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted van hitbox[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed animation error on player(bird)[/p][/*][*][p]Pixelation effect does not reset when restarting the game[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45702466/2b0a82b4cc7e706dbeee95c67923eeb9a8303d1d.png"][/img][/p]
